evidence_basis: Published source theory. Source auditing and comparisons are not independent recalculation or experimental validation.

prior.summary: Exact ordered-state mechanism new to reviewed catalogue only; source predictions/known chemistry acknowledged, not first discovery.

Bounded primary phase search has not tied the exact target order to an established SC sample; no global absence claim.

sources.title: Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds
Primary source study: conventional superconducting compounds

prior.claim_boundary: Every listed state already has a published source prediction. Related compositions or phases are not experimental confirmation of this exact state. This dossier does not establish global novelty or an exhaustive literature search.

bottleneck.summary: The A Eliashberg benefit is only 0.058 K (McMillan and Allen–Dynes +0.051 K), not a demonstrated robust improvement; the A fine F is 16.80 meV/atom higher. The support grade is for the bounded phase/network hypothesis with explicit opposite λ, not a significant global potential ranking.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Exact model force/full stress, converged electronic outputs, reported finite-q workflow and raw Γ optical evidence provide a bounded near-ambient source-model screen. Source residual stress/metastable alternatives remain explicit; this is not proof of synthesizeability, full BZ or global equilibrium.

counterevidence.scope: Coupling and separate source-model Tc move in opposite directions against the selected source control; a monotonic coupling-to-Tc explanation is insufficient.

unknowns: Experimental superconductivity in this exact state
Direct support for approximately 300 K at ambient pressure

proposed_contribution.intervention: Both ordered tetragonal phases have strongly different Ru/Tc like-species separations (about 2.71258 versus 3.83478 Å). λ favors B in all ten rows, whereas ω and all three separate Tc products favor A. This is a geometry/pairing tradeoff vector, not monotonic λ optimization. Complete species-channel geometry differences and computed all-σ pairing response are saved against the frozen controls. Cell/grid/method sensitivity prevents a pure geometry-only causal claim; no bandwidth/carrier quantity is substituted.
proposed_contribution.next_action: Freeze A/B identity and test the tradeoff at matched grids and common product definitions. If all Tc benefits vanish or change sign while B keeps greater λ, downgrade the claim of A benefit; no maximum-σ or outcome-based comparator substitution.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
